This inspection document intentionally avoids `HTML(...)` and does not add
pandas/polars dependencies. It shows the current safe surface for dataframe-like
content: plain text/repr output and explicit Markdown tables.

```{python}
rows = [
    {"name": "Ada", "score": 98, "group": "analysis"},
    {"name": "Grace", "score": 95, "group": "systems"},
    {"name": "Katherine", "score": 99, "group": "orbits"},
]

print("DATAFRAME_STATUS pandas/polars auto-rendering is not part of the current committed surface")
rows
```

The raw Python object above is intentionally plain text/repr-style output.

```{python}
from uv_python_runtime import display, Markdown, Text

def markdown_table(records):
    headers = list(records[0])
    lines = [
        "| " + " | ".join(headers) + " |",
        "| " + " | ".join(["---"] * len(headers)) + " |",
    ]
    for record in records:
        lines.append("| " + " | ".join(str(record[key]) for key in headers) + " |")
    return "\n".join(lines)

display(Text("DATAFRAME_TEXT_OUTPUT list-of-dicts stays plain text unless explicitly converted"))
display(Markdown(markdown_table(rows)))
```

The table above is the recommended dependency-free current path: explicit
Markdown table output.

```{python}
try:
    import pandas as pd
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    print("PANDAS_STATUS pandas is not installed in this uv project")
else:
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    print("PANDAS_STATUS pandas is installed; showing plain text to avoid raw HTML")
    print(df.to_string(index=False))
```
